one_line: Self-taught South Indian mathematical genius whose ideas reshaped modern number theory at Cambridge.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s to early-30s, slender and slightly frail build
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, thoughtful dark eyes, slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed moustache, default expression calm and intensely focused as if mid-calculation
appearance.hair: short, side-parted straight black hair combed back from the forehead, tidy and slightly glossy, no headwear
appearance.costume: Early 1910s South Indian–British scholar look: a simple, well-pressed dark charcoal-grey wool suit (single-breasted jacket with notched lapels and three buttons, matching trousers), under it a crisp white cotton shirt with a slightly rounded collar, and a slim dark navy tie; feet in plain black leather lace-up Oxford shoes with a modest shine; in Indian scenes he keeps the same shirt and trousers but replaces the suit jacket with a lightweight off-white cotton long-sleeve shirt layer resembling a formal bush-shirt cut, and a soft grey wool shawl occasionally draped over his shoulders for warmth, all tailored and modest, with no ornate patterns aside from very subtle pinstripes in the suit fabric.
appearance.signature: A worn, brown leather-bound notebook held in one hand, pages densely filled with tiny handwritten formulas, plus a simple wooden fountain pen tucked between the fingers.

ref_desc: Srinivasa Ramanujan is a slender, medium-brown South Indian man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, neat moustache, wearing a dark charcoal-grey suit with white shirt and navy tie, black Oxford shoes, and carrying a brown leather notebook with formulas.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Srinivasa Ramanujan: a slender South Indian man in his late twenties with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, thoughtful dark eyes, straight nose and a neat small moustache. His short black hair is side-parted and combed back smoothly, with no headwear. He wears a dark charcoal-grey single-breasted suit, the jacket with notched lapels and three buttons and matching trousers with a slight crease, over a crisp white cotton shirt with a slightly rounded collar, and a slim dark navy tie. His shoes are plain black leather lace-up Oxfords with a modest shine. His one signature prop is a worn brown leather-bound notebook, held in one hand and clearly full of tightly written mathematical formulas, with a simple wooden fountain pen visible between his fingers. Keep the palette to charcoal grey, white, navy blue, black and medium brown, and show him front, side and back in the same consistent outfit so this design can be redrawn identically in many panels.
